s2.ptxt: Insert the condenser assembly (with receiver) from above.
Remove the vinyl tape wrapped around the joints of the discharge hose and condenser assembly (with receiver).
Apply sufficient compressor oil (ND-OIL8) to a new O-ring and install it to the discharge hose.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow dirt or foreign matter to adhere to the O-ring or O-ring sealing surface.

s2.ptxt: Install the discharge hose to the condenser assembly (with receiver) with the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Install Air Conditioner Tube & Accessory Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the vinyl tape wrapped around the joints of the air conditioner tube & accessory assembly and condenser assembly (with receiver).
Apply sufficient compressor oil (ND-OIL8) to a new O-ring and install it to the air conditioner tube & accessory assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Do not allow dirt or foreign matter to adhere to the O-ring or O-ring sealing surface.

s2.ptxt: Install the air conditioner tube & accessory assembly to the condenser assembly (with receiver) with the bolt.
Install fan shroud No.2 to the radiator assembly with the 2 bolts.
Attach the 2 horn assembly connectors to fan shroud No.2 with the 2 clamps.
Install the radiator support assembly with the 4 bolts.
Connect the 2 horn assembly connectors.
Install the water bypass hose to the radiator support assembly with the 2 bolts and 2 clamps.
Install the radiator side cover RH with the 2 clamps.
Install the radiator side cover LH with the 3 clamps and guide.

s-1.ptxt: Install Millimeter Wave Radar Sensor Bracket NO.1 (w/ Radar Cruise)

s2.ptxt: Temporarily install the millimeter wave radar sensor bracket with the 4 bolts.
Fully tighten the bolts in the order A, B, C, D.

s-1.ptxt: Install Millimeter Wave Radar Sensor Assembly (w/ Radar Cruise)

s2.ptxt: Temporarily install the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly with the 3 bolts.
Fully tighten the bolts in the order A, B, C.
Connect the connector.

atten3.ptxt: Do not use a sensor that has been dropped or subjected to a strong impact during work.

s2.ptxt: Install the hood lock assembly with the 3 bolts.
Attach the hood lock control cable assembly to the 2 clamps.
Install the battery to the vehicle.
Install the insulator.
Install the battery clamp with the bolt and nut.
Connect the battery positive terminal with the nut. (*1)
Evacuate the system using a vacuum pump.
Charge with refrigerant HFC-134a (R134a).

atten3.ptxt: Never operate the cooler compressor before charging refrigerant, as operating it without refrigerant may cause it to seize due to insufficient lubrication.

atten4.ptxt: When reusing recovered refrigerant gas, the recovery rate of the refrigerant recovery/recycling machine is approximately 90%, so additional refrigerant from a service can is required when recharging; prepare it in advance.

atten3.ptxt: After charging with refrigerant, perform a break-in operation at 2000r/min or less for 2 minutes or more.

s2.ptxt: After charging the refrigerant gas, inspect for refrigerant gas leaks using a halogen leak detector.
Connect the connectors.
Engage the 8 claws (4 each on LH/RH).
Install the front bumper assembly with the 5 clips, 2 bolts and 6 screws.
Install the pin hold clip.

atten4.ptxt: Install the RH side using the same procedure.

s2.ptxt: Install the 2 radiator grille protectors.
Install the engine under cover with the 4 bolts and 4 screws.
Install the radiator upper air deflector with the 8 clips.

s-1.ptxt: Adjust Millimeter Wave Radar Sensor Assembly

item.ptxt: Perform the measurement on a level floor.

Check that there are no metal objects in the surrounding area or on the floor surface. (The area approximately 10m ahead and approximately 14m wide is a prohibited area for objects. It is preferable that there are no large metal objects around it either.)

s2.ptxt: Pre-adjustment Work

s3.ptxt: Unload all luggage from the vehicle.
Leave only the standard tools and spare tire in the trunk.
Adjust the tire pressure to the specified value.
Reduce the remaining fuel to less than 15L.

s2.ptxt: Vertical Adjustment

s3.ptxt: Remove dust and oil from the level shelf of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly.
Place the dedicated level in the center of the level shelf of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly.
Using a screwdriver, turn vertical adjusting bolt A of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly to adjust so that the bubble is on the red line of the level.

atten4.ptxt: Adjustment range within red frame of level ±0.2°

item.ptxt: Upward: Turn bolt A to the minus side
Downward: Turn bolt A to the plus side

entry.ptxt: 1 turn of the screwdriver moves it approximately 0.12°

s2.ptxt: SST (Reflector) Height Adjustment

s3.ptxt: Set SST (reflector) at a height of 70cm from the ground.

s2.ptxt: SST (Reflector) Setting

s3.ptxt: Hang a pointed weight from the center (emblem center) of the front and rear bumpers of the vehicle, and accurately mark the center positions on the floor surface.
Make a mark 5m ahead of the vehicle on the line connecting the 2 front and rear points.

atten4.ptxt: Fix one end of a string to the rear mark, and from 5m ahead of the vehicle, move the other end of the string left and right to align it with the front mark and establish a straight line.

s3.ptxt: Set SST (reflector) at a position shifted 12mm to the right of the vehicle from the marking position.

s2.ptxt: Beam Axis Adjustment

s3.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to the vehicle.
Turn IG ON.
Turn the cruise control main switch ON.
On the screen, select "Work Support" → "Radar Cruise" → "Millimeter Wave Radar Beam Axis Adjustment" in that order.
Follow the screen instructions and press the "Start" button.

atten3.ptxt: Check that the beam axis distance is approximately 5m.

s2.ptxt: Horizontal Adjustment

s3.ptxt: Read the current angle deviation.
Based on the beam axis deviation measurement result, use a screwdriver to turn horizontal adjusting bolt B of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly to adjust it.

item.ptxt: Upward: Turn bolt B to the plus side
Downward: Turn bolt B to the minus side

entry.ptxt: 1 turn of the screwdriver moves it approximately 0.05°

atten3.ptxt: If it is difficult to reach 0°, the sensor may be targeting an object other than SST (reflector), so check again that there are no highly reflective objects in the surrounding area.

s3.ptxt: To reset the driving learned value, cover the left half of the sensor with aluminum foil, etc. (a metal object that blocks radio waves). (For approximately 10 seconds)

atten3.ptxt: At this time, leave SST (reflector) installed, and make sure there are no objects between the right half of the sensor and the reflector.

atten4.ptxt: When reset, the buzzer sounds for 10 seconds and the screen displays "Beam Axis Deviation 6.3°" and "Beam Axis Distance 6.3m".

s3.ptxt: Press the "Complete" button to end the beam axis adjustment mode.
Disconnect SST (TaSCAN) from the vehicle.

s2.ptxt: Recheck Vertical Adjustment

s3.ptxt: Place the dedicated level in the center of the level shelf of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly.
Using a screwdriver, turn vertical adjusting bolt A of the millimeter wave radar sensor assembly to readjust so that the bubble is on the red line of the level.

atten4.ptxt: Adjustment range within red frame of level ±0.2°

item.ptxt: Upward: Turn bolt A to the minus side
Downward: Turn bolt A to the plus side

entry.ptxt: 1 turn of the screwdriver moves it approximately 0.12°
